description: LION on LUT with betas=(0.9,0.93) at lut_lr=2e-4 — β2 refinement below exp453's 0.95 (which BEAT AdamW: 1.4967 vs 1.4983). Probes the lower side of the β2 sweet spot: 0.90=Signum≈AdamW (1.5023), 0.95 beats Adam (1.4967), 0.99 bad (~+0.05). Is the optimum below 0.95 or does 0.93 fall back toward Signum? β1=0.9, non-LUT stay AdamW. Also saves checkpoint.pt at end (first LION-LUT run with a saved checkpoint).
